specs.Compatible Devices: 4G Networks (Jio, Airtel, VI, BSNL), Single SIM slot

features: Premium Flip Design for All Major Networks — Stylish, durable flip phone with full 2.8" main screen + 1.4" outer display. Works on Jio, Airtel, VI, and BSNL 4G networks.

CareTouch App: Remotely Configure Phone from Anywhere — Authorised family members can set contacts, reminders, SOS settings & volume from anywhere in the world. Auto-pickup & auto-callback for missed calls.

SOS Emergency Help Button - Stay safe with a dedicated SOS button. With single key-press, instantly trigger emergency calls , SMS alerts, and a loud siren — critical for timely help during medical or personal emergencies.
Block Spam & Fraud Calls with Safelist — Only receive calls from up to 50 trusted contacts. Eliminate telemarketing and scam calls — built specifically for senior safety.

Loud & Clear Audio with Boost Option - Enjoy clear, loud sound with volume boost for better audibility. Distinct ringtones ensure incoming calls are never missed — ideal for those with hearing difficulties.

Senior-Friendly Features for Effortless Calling - Customizable menu to hide unused options, large backlit talking number keys, and 8 photo speed dials make calling intuitive and stress-free for elderly users.
Dock Charger + USB-C + 1400mAh Battery — 300 hours standby time. No cable fumbling: slide phone onto dock once installed. USB-C backup cable included.
